Dear Ms García,

I am writing to recommend Diego Romero as a tenant for your flat. I have known Diego for over eight years. We first met at university in Seville, and since moving to Madrid we have remained close friends.

Diego is one of the most reliable and responsible people I know. He always pays his bills on time and keeps his promises, however small. For instance, when my wife and I were away for a month last summer, Diego looked after our flat. He watered the plants, checked the post and even fixed a dripping tap without being asked.

He is also quiet, tidy and considerate. He gets on well with everyone in his current building, and his neighbours often ask him for help. In addition, he has a stable job as an accountant, so I have no doubt that he can afford the rent.

I have no hesitation in recommending him, and I am confident that he would be an excellent tenant. Please do not hesitate to contact me if you need any further information.

Kind regards,
Oliver

Dear Ms Hughes,\n\nI am writing to apply:
Dear Ms Hughes,

I am writing to apply for the role of volunteer assistant at the Welcome Centre, which I saw advertised on your website.

Having moved to Leeds from Colombia myself, I know how confusing the first few weeks in a new country can be, from registering an address to finding a doctor. I would love to help other newcomers through that process.

Last year I helped several friends fill in official forms and translated at meetings with landlords and schools. I speak Spanish and German, and my English is improving fast. I would describe myself as patient, reliable and well organised, and I enjoy working with people.

I am available on weekday evenings and at weekends, and I could commit to around six hours a week. I would also be happy to attend any training you provide.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss it with you.

Yours sincerely,
Oliver
